{{Top|leg}}
A '''summat''' was a seasonal event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. The tribal leaders of the [[Fyodoi]] would meet, and after a great feast, discuss tribal matters. Before the feast, the tribal [[Chief/Legends|chiefs]] would gather in the middle of a specially constructed circle of [[straw]] huts, and shout gibberish at one another for four hours, followed by burning down all the huts save one. The ceremony was a symbolic reenactment of the events leading up to the [[Great Cleansing]], and the war that followed.
